en: "Kh! A Romulus Special Service unit?{n} Out looking for a way through and{n} we run into the enemy. Rotten luck!"

"When he was killing our comrades,{n} he even had a faint smile{n} on his lips!"
"Aerial! Run!{n} At least! At least you!"
"I do not go back on my word!{n} Now, hurry up and kill me!"
"This girl stayed with us through{n} the dangers of the battlefield and{n} did her duty as an army chaplain!"
"At times she even ignored army{n} regulations and treated{n} dying enemy soldiers!"
"In this war-torn age, she truly{n} keeps to a priest's teachings!"
"Please! I don't matter!{n} But this girl! Just this girl,{n} let her go!"
"Sorry, but this is a battlefield.{n} Not some backstreet playhouse."
"A cheap tearjerker gets no applause{n} out here, and nobody's going{n} to listen to it..."
"In honor of your hammy little act,{n} I'll let you die easy.{n} That's my idea of mercy."
